comment: Byte ceilings for what a COLD load pays before any route code runs. Raise a limit only with a measurement in the PR that explains what the bytes buy.

apps/app.comment: Entry chunk + transitive STATIC imports + entry CSS. Lazy route chunks are excluded: they are paid on navigation, not on boot. Includes the route loader that resolves the shell's opening decision before first paint — it costs ~4.6 KB gzip and removes three full-viewport paints from a cold load, which is a trade worth making explicitly. React, React Router and Zod are split into vendor chunks: that costs ~600 B gzip in boundary overhead and buys cache stability, since an edit under lib/api used to invalidate React Router for every returning reader. eager_css_gzip rose 96 B (22243 to 22339, owner 16 Nov 2026, PR #933): Tailwind compiles the lazy Actions v3 tree's own geometry rules (row grid at two breakpoints, 76px goal cell, strip hairline, indents, dock offset) into the entry CSS; measured 80 B over after cutting the rest.
